rules.name: Numeral denotes value
preconditions: n is a valid numeral in the active numeral system
rules.operation: Interpret the numeral as the value represented by its digits and sign.
counterexamples: --7 is not a numeral in strict mode
common_errors: Treating notation artifacts as values

rules.name: Place value in base 10
rules.output_form: sum of digits times powers of ten
preconditions: Each d_i is a digit from 0 to 9
rules.operation: Interpret the numeral as the sum of each digit multiplied by its place value.
counterexamples: Digit 12 inside a single decimal place is invalid

rules.name: Equality reflexive
preconditions: Equality relation is defined in the domain
rules.operation: Every object equals itself.

rules.name: Equality symmetric
rules.operation: Reverse a true equality without changing truth value.

rules.name: Equality transitive
rules.operation: Compose equalities transitively.

rules.name: Order comparison on ordered domains
preconditions: The domain has an order relation
rules.operation: Evaluate the order relation between two values.
counterexamples: i < 1 is invalid in C under standard ordering
common_errors: Assuming all numeric domains are ordered

rules.name: Unary plus
rules.operation: Unary plus leaves value unchanged.

rules.name: Unary minus
rules.operation: Produce the additive inverse of the operand.
counterexamples: Unary minus on a natural number may leave the natural-number domain

rules.name: Double negative
rules.operation: Two additive inversions cancel.

rules.name: Addition closure by domain
preconditions: a and b belong to a domain closed under addition
rules.operation: Add two values within a domain closed under addition.
counterexamples: Adding incompatible object types is invalid
common_errors: Ignoring domain mismatch

rules.name: Addition commutative
rules.operation: Swap operands in addition without changing value.
counterexamples: String concatenation is not arithmetic addition

rules.name: Addition associative
rules.operation: Regroup addition without changing value.

rules.name: Additive identity
rules.operation: Adding zero leaves the value unchanged.

rules.name: Additive inverse
preconditions: The additive inverse exists in the domain
rules.operation: Add a number to its additive inverse.
counterexamples: In N without negatives, -6 is outside the domain

rules.name: Atomic addition of small naturals
rules.operation: Combine counts directly.

rules.name: Column addition with carry
preconditions: Operands are written in positional notation
rules.operation: Add digits by place from right to left and carry when the partial sum reaches the base.
counterexamples: Failing to add the carry gives 95, which is false
common_errors: Dropping the carry digit

rules.name: Fraction addition with common denominator
rules.operation: Add numerators while keeping the common denominator.
common_errors: Multiplying denominators unnecessarily

rules.name: Fraction addition with different denominators
rules.operation: Convert to a common denominator and add the adjusted numerators.
common_errors: Adding numerator to numerator and denominator to denominator

rules.name: Decimal addition
rules.operation: Align decimal places and then add positionally.
common_errors: Misaligning decimal points

rules.name: Subtraction as additive inverse
rules.operation: Rewrite subtraction as addition of the additive inverse.

rules.name: Subtraction identity
rules.operation: Subtracting zero leaves the value unchanged.

rules.name: Self-subtraction
rules.operation: Subtract a value from itself.

rules.name: Subtraction is not commutative
rules.operation: Record that swapping subtraction operands changes the result in general.
counterexamples: Equal operands are a special case: 4 - 4 = 4 - 4
common_errors: Swapping operands as if subtraction behaved like addition

rules.name: Borrowing in positional subtraction
preconditions: Operands are written in positional notation
rules.operation: Borrow from the next higher place when the current digit is too small.
common_errors: Forgetting to decrement the higher place after borrowing

rules.name: Natural-number subtraction restriction
preconditions: a and b are natural numbers
rules.operation: If a < b, subtraction may fail in N and require promotion to Z.
common_errors: Assuming subtraction always stays inside N

rules.name: Multiplication closure
preconditions: The domain is closed under multiplication
rules.operation: Multiply two values in a multiplicatively closed domain.

rules.name: Multiplication commutative
rules.operation: Swap multiplication operands without changing value.

rules.name: Multiplication associative
rules.operation: Regroup multiplication without changing value.

rules.name: Multiplicative identity
rules.operation: Multiplying by one leaves value unchanged.

rules.name: Zero product with zero operand
rules.operation: Any value multiplied by zero gives zero.

rules.name: Repeated addition interpretation
rules.output_form: a added to itself b times
rules.operation: Interpret multiplication as repeated addition in whole-number contexts.
counterexamples: This interpretation does not directly define 4 * 1/2
common_errors: Overextending repeated addition to all domains without redefinition

rules.name: Sign rules for multiplication
rules.operation: Determine the sign of a product from operand signs.
common_errors: Treating negative times negative as negative

rules.name: Distributive law
rules.operation: Distribute multiplication over addition.
common_errors: Failing to distribute to every term

rules.name: Fraction multiplication
rules.operation: Multiply numerators and denominators.

rules.name: Decimal multiplication
rules.operation: Multiply as integers, then place the decimal according to total decimal places.
common_errors: Misplacing the decimal point

rules.name: Division as inverse multiplication
rules.operation: Rewrite division as multiplication by a reciprocal when the reciprocal is defined.

rules.name: Division by one
rules.operation: Dividing by one leaves the value unchanged.

rules.name: Zero dividend
rules.operation: Zero divided by a nonzero divisor is zero.
common_errors: Confusing 0/a with a/0

rules.name: Division by zero forbidden
rules.operation: Reject division by zero as undefined in standard arithmetic.
examples: 0 / 0 is invalid and indeterminate in many extended contexts
counterexamples: 5 / 0 = infinity is not standard arithmetic equality
common_errors: Assigning an ordinary numeric value to division by zero

rules.name: Division is not commutative
rules.operation: Record that swapping dividend and divisor changes the value in general.

rules.name: Division is not associative
rules.operation: Record that regrouping division changes value in general.

rules.name: Exact division in integers
rules.operation: When the divisor divides the dividend evenly, the quotient remains in Z.
counterexamples: 7 / 2 is not an integer, though it is valid in Q and equals 7/2

rules.name: Fraction well-formedness
rules.operation: Recognize a rational fraction only when the denominator is nonzero.

rules.name: Equivalent fractions
rules.operation: Multiply numerator and denominator by the same nonzero factor.

rules.name: Fraction reduction
preconditions: numerator and denominator share a nonzero common factor
rules.operation: Divide numerator and denominator by a common factor.
common_errors: Cancelling terms that are not common factors

rules.name: Improper fraction to mixed number
rules.operation: Rewrite an improper positive fraction as a whole-number part plus a proper fraction.

rules.name: Fraction comparison by common denominator
rules.operation: Compare fractions by converting to a common denominator or cross-multiplying when valid.

rules.name: Decimal to fraction conversion
rules.operation: Convert a finite decimal to a rational fraction and reduce if desired.

rules.name: Fraction to decimal conversion
rules.operation: Divide numerator by denominator to obtain a terminating or repeating decimal.

rules.name: Trailing zero invariance
rules.operation: Appending trailing zeros after the decimal point does not change value.
common_errors: Confusing place value when inserting zeros inside the decimal

rules.name: Ratio interpretation
rules.operation: Interpret a ratio as a comparison and, when appropriate, as a fraction.

rules.name: Percentage definition
rules.operation: Interpret percent as per hundred.

rules.name: Percentage of quantity
rules.operation: Compute a percentage of a quantity by converting the percent to a fraction or decimal multiplier.

rules.name: Positive integer exponent
rules.operation: Interpret positive integer exponentiation as repeated multiplication.

rules.name: Exponent identity one
rules.operation: Exponent one returns the base.

rules.name: Exponent zero
rules.operation: A nonzero base raised to the zero power equals one.
counterexamples: 0^0 must not be silently forced to 1 in this rule set
common_errors: Applying the zero-exponent rule to 0^0 without context

rules.name: Product of same base
preconditions: Exponents are in a domain where the rule is valid
rules.operation: Add exponents when multiplying like bases.
common_errors: Using the rule on unlike bases

rules.name: Power of power
rules.operation: Multiply exponents when raising a power to another power.

rules.name: Product power rule
rules.operation: Distribute an exponent over a product when the rule is valid in the domain.

rules.name: Negative exponent
rules.operation: Rewrite a negative exponent as the reciprocal of a positive exponent.

rules.name: Square root over reals
rules.operation: Return the principal square root in the real numbers.
counterexamples: sqrt(9) = -3 is false under principal-root convention
sqrt(-1) is invalid in real-only mode
common_errors: Confusing the equation y^2 = x with the principal root function

rules.name: nth root domain rule
rules.output_form: root value if domain allows it
preconditions: Validity depends on parity of n and active domain
rules.operation: Determine root existence and value from degree parity and domain.
examples: fourth_root(16) = 2 as principal root in R

rules.name: Root and power interaction
rules.operation: Simplify the square root of a square in the reals using absolute value.
counterexamples: sqrt(a^2) = a is false in general over R
common_errors: Dropping the absolute value

rules.name: Absolute value definition
rules.operation: Return a if a is nonnegative and -a if a is negative.

rules.name: Nonnegativity of absolute value
rules.operation: Absolute value is never negative in ordered real-like domains.

rules.name: Product rule for absolute value
rules.operation: Distribute absolute value over multiplication.

rules.name: Explicit grouping first
rules.operation: Evaluate grouped subexpressions before surrounding operations.

rules.name: Exponent before multiplication and addition
rules.operation: Apply exponentiation before multiplication and addition unless grouping overrides it.

rules.name: Multiplication and division before addition and subtraction
rules.operation: Apply multiplication and division before addition and subtraction unless grouping overrides it.

rules.name: Left-to-right for equal precedence
rules.operation: Evaluate multiplication/division and addition/subtraction left to right when precedence is equal.

rules.name: Minimal domain promotion
rules.operation: Promote to the smallest standard domain that contains the result.
examples: sqrt(2) promotes from Q to R
sqrt(-1) promotes from R to C

rules.name: Domain failure without promotion
rules.operation: Emit a domain error instead of silently changing domains.
examples: In strict natural-number mode, 3 - 5 is a domain error

rules.name: Invalid fraction addition heuristic
rules.operation: Mark this pattern as invalid.
common_errors: Adding numerator to numerator and denominator to denominator

rules.name: Cancelling across addition is invalid
rules.operation: Mark cancellation across addition as invalid.
common_errors: Cancelling terms that are not multiplicative factors

rules.name: Square root distribution error
rules.operation: Mark naive square-root distribution over addition as invalid.

rules.name: Division by zero shortcut error
rules.operation: Mark assigning zero to division by zero as invalid.

rules.name: Divisibility definition
rules.output_form: exists integer k with a = bk
rules.operation: Interpret divisibility by existence of an integer multiplier.

rules.name: Prime number criterion
rules.operation: Classify p as prime when its only positive divisors are 1 and p.

rules.name: Greatest common divisor
preconditions: a and b are not both zero
rules.operation: Return the greatest positive integer dividing both a and b.

rules.name: Least common multiple
rules.operation: Return the least positive integer divisible by both a and b.
counterexamples: 48 is a common multiple of 6 and 8, but not the least one

rules.name: Modular congruence
rules.input_form: a congruent to b mod n
rules.operation: Interpret congruence modulo n as divisibility of the difference by n.

rules.name: Signed change in word problems
rules.input_form: gains and losses as signed quantities
preconditions: Positive and negative directions are declared consistently
rules.operation: Represent gains as positive and losses as negative, then add signed quantities.
examples: A gain of 8 and a loss of 3 produce net change 5
counterexamples: Treating every change as positive loses direction information

rules.name: Unit-aware addition
rules.output_form: sum in a common compatible unit
preconditions: Units are identical or converted to a compatible common unit first
rules.operation: Add measured quantities only after unit compatibility has been established.
counterexamples: 2 meters + 3 seconds is invalid as ordinary addition of physical quantities
